mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS name, m.EMAIL AS email, m.REGION_SIDO AS regionSido, m.REGION_SIGUNGU AS regionSigungu, TO_CHAR(m.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM MEMBER m WHERE m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND m.BANNED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY m.CREATED_AT DESC, m.MEMBER_ID DESC

SELECT m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS name, m.EMAIL AS email, s.SANCTION_ID AS latestSanctionId, s.REASON AS reason, s.ISSUED_ADMIN_ID AS issuedAdminId, a.NAME AS issuedAdminName, TO_CHAR(s.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS bannedAt FROM MEMBER m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SANCTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, REASON, ISSUED_ADMIN_ID, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT SANCTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, REASON, ISSUED_ADMIN_ID, CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY MEMBER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, SANCTION_ID DESC ) AS rn FROM SANCTION WHERE SANCTION_TYPE = 'BAN' ) WHERE rn = 1 ) s ON s.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON a.ADMIN_ID = s.ISSUED_ADMIN_ID WHERE m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND m.BANNED_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, m.MEMBER_ID DESC
SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, STATUS AS status, BANNED_YN AS bannedYn FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SANCTION ( SANCTION_ID, SANCTION_TYPE, MEMBER_ID, GROUP_ID, ISSUED_MEMBER_ID, ISSUED_ADMIN_ID, REASON, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{sanctionId}, #{sanctionType}, #{memberId}, NULL, NULL, #{adminId}, #{reason}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, ACTOR_ADMIN_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, NULL, NULL, #{adminId}, #{targetMemberId}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT gm.GYE_MEMBER_ID AS gyeMemberId, gm.GROUP_ID AS groupId, g.TITLE AS groupTitle, g.STATUS AS groupStatus, gm.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS memberName, gm.WARNING_COUNT AS warningCount, TO_CHAR(gm.JOINED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS joinedAt FROM GYE_MEMBER gm JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = gm.GROUP_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID WHERE gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND gm.WARNING_COUNT > 0 ORDER BY gm.WARNING_COUNT DESC, gm.GROUP_ID ASC, gm.MEMBER_ID ASC

where.if: AND ( LOWER(NVL(m.NAME, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{escapedKeyword}) || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(NVL(g.TITLE, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{escapedKeyword}) || '%' ESCAPE '\' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SANCTION s JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = s.GROUP_ID

SELECT s.SANCTION_ID AS sanctionId, s.SANCTION_TYPE AS sanctionType, s.GROUP_ID AS groupId, NVL(g.TITLE, '모임 미지정') AS groupTitle, s.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS memberName, s.ISSUED_MEMBER_ID AS issuedMemberId, im.NAME AS issuedMemberName, s.ISSUED_ADMIN_ID AS issuedAdminId, ia.NAME AS issuedAdminName, s.REASON AS reason, TO_CHAR(s.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM SANCTION s JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = s.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER im ON im.MEMBER_ID = s.ISSUED_MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ADMIN ia ON ia.ADMIN_ID = s.ISSUED_ADMIN_ID
ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC, s.SANCTION_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
